definitions.page_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the assembled page

definitions.markup_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of the page without its style and script blocks
definitions.markup_lines: lines of the page without its style and script blocks
definitions.css_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of all inline style blocks
definitions.css_gzip6_bytes: gzip level 6 of all inline style blocks

definitions.js_bytes: UTF-8 bytes of all inline script blocks
definitions.js_lines: lines of all inline script blocks

definitions.color_occurrences: all hex and rgb()/rgba() colour texts in the CSS
definitions.distinct_font_sizes: distinct font-size values in the CSS
definitions.distinct_margin_values: distinct margin values in the CSS
definitions.distinct_padding_values: distinct padding values in the CSS
definitions.distinct_gap_values: distinct gap values in the CSS
definitions.distinct_z_indexes: distinct z-index values in the CSS
definitions.distinct_border_radii: distinct border-radius values in the CSS
definitions.root_rules: :root rules in the CSS, inside media queries too
